text:
zoe_sales: Starlight bank asked for a quick POC next week. Requirements: streaming (low-latency), function/tool-calls for transaction extraction, strict JSON schema enforcement, SAML + customer KMS, and a procurement-friendly delta for reserved vs hosted. Can eng produce runnable samples in ~48h?

ben_eng: Yep. We can assemble a minimal Node WS sample + Python SSE fallback and a tiny replay driver to approximate 800-1k QPS. Will keep the sample focused on tool-calls + schema validation. Example WS send for demo: ```js
ws.send(JSON.stringify({input:'extract_tx',stream:true}));
```

maya_se: For structured output, we'll demo function-calls with an explicit JSON Schema and show the validator returning structured errors. Expected success payload: `{"tool":"extract_tx","args":{"sender":"string","recipient":"string","amount":{"type":"number","currency":"USD"}}}`. On mismatch return: `{"error":{"code":"SCHEMA_MISMATCH","path":"/args/amount","received":"string"}}`.

ben_eng: Ops notes: recommend a small reserved pool for steady tail-latency. Batching window 10-25ms usually balances cost vs latency. Fallback policy: overflow -> cheaper model variant, mark with header `x-redwood-fallback: true`. For API creds use ephemeral tokens (TTL configurable 15m-1h). KMS: we support AWS/GCP CMKs and HSM integrations.

otto_ops: I'll provision a reserved sandbox once we have the replay script. Need sample prompts and KMS key arn. Deploy bot can create a sandbox cluster.

deploy_bot: sandbox created: sandbox-starlight-01. Endpoint: https://sandbox.redwood.ai/starlight

claire_legal: Send security questionnaire to legal@redwood.ai. Upload link for Starlight: https://onetrust.example.com/starlight-upload. They want SOC2 report, KMS key policy, and residency notes. I'll prepare NDA and the standard security pack.

ben_eng: Quick procurement ballpark (very rough): reserved small pool (4x A100 equiv) for 1k QPS text gen ~ "$32k/mo"; hosted autoscale with batching and prefix caching ~ "$19k/mo". I'll produce a token-based calc tomorrow with sample prompt sizes.

maya_se: Demo tip: show a short UI that validates returned JSON against schema and highlights field errors, then show auto-retry when integrator supplies a corrected prompt. Also demonstrate a 422-style structured error body so downstream systems can handle it deterministically.

otto_ops: Timeline: collect Starlight sample prompts today, run replay + perf tomorrow morning, live demo Wed 3pm PT. I'll loop in infra if we hit capacity.

zoe_sales: Great — I'll ask Starlight for sample prompts and their security contact now. @claire_legal I'll send the NDA. :thumbsup: 

ben_eng: Small routing + batching YAML we'll show: ```yaml
route_policy:
  - match: high_traffic
    capacity: reserved:starlight-01
    fallback: redwood-lite
batching:
  max_delay_ms: 20
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```

zoe_sales: Thanks team, ping me if anything blocks. I'll update the Starlight deck with these points.
